structure_policy_rationale: 参考 bilibili 和 kuaishou 的案例，当原始图标主体为清晰的物体或角色轮廓时，应保留其物理拓扑结构。金铲铲的企鹅形象具有极高的辨识度，且轮廓清晰（圆头+头盔突起+手持物），适合直接进行风格化转译，而非像 LOL 那样重构为抽象符号。需保留企鹅与铲子的空间位置关系。
preserve: 企鹅的圆润头部与身体基本比例
头盔顶部的尖角结构与护耳轮廓
右手持有的铲子形状（长柄+带孔铲头）
企鹅面部的大眼睛与嘴巴位置
must_preserve: 铲子的基本形状（长柄+带孔铲头）
recompose_allowed: 将3D立体光影转化为平涂色块
将复杂的眼睛细节简化为简单的黑色圆点或几何图形
将原本丰富的色彩映射为复古三原色（如头盔用深蓝或奶黄，铲子用奶黄）
边缘处理为不规则的手绘抖动线条
restyle: 去除所有金属光泽、高光和阴影
应用粗犷、不均匀的黑色手绘描边
使用蜡笔/粉笔质感的哑光填充
将色彩限制在砖红、深宝蓝、暖黄/米白范围内
forbid: 禁止保留原图的3D渲染质感和高光
禁止使用原图的复杂渐变色背景
禁止出现除红蓝黄白黑以外的颜色（如原本的紫色、浅蓝色需转换）
禁止线条过于平滑锐利，必须体现手绘感
禁止将企鹅误画为其他鸟类
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Centered simplified penguin wearing a helmet and holding a spatula. Flat colors (brick red, deep blue, creamy yellow) with thick, rough marker strokes. No gradients, no shadows, no 3D effects. Naive, cute geometric block composition.
color_application: Map original metallic/silver helmet to Deep Blue or Creamy Yellow flat blocks; map golden spatula to Creamy/Yellow flat block; map penguin body to White/Black blocks. Strictly use high-saturation limited palette (Red/Blue/Yellow/White) on #000000 background.
stroke_application: Apply thick, uneven, hand-drawn black outlines to all shapes (penguin, helmet, spatula). Edges must be rough and jittery, simulating marker pen traces, avoiding smooth vector curves.
composition_application: Center the penguin figure occupying 60-70% of the canvas. Maintain the spatial relationship of helmet on head and spatula in hand. Remove all background elements except pure black.
identity_application: Preserve the specific topology of the 'helmeted penguin' and the 'spatula' prop. Simplify details but keep the iconic silhouette recognizable. Do not abstract into generic symbols; keep the character form.
fidelity_constraints: Must apply thick, rough hand-drawn strokes
Must use flat colors without gradients or shadows
Must limit colors to theme palette (Red, Blue, Yellow/White)
Must retain the core silhouette of the helmeted penguin and spatula
negative_constraints: No realistic 3D rendering or glossy textures
No complex backgrounds or lighting effects
No colors outside the theme palette (e.g., green, purple, pink)
No removal of key identity props (helmet, spatula)
